label: Intrinsic existence reason: source-indexed positive arguments and typed candidate elimination
summary: Materialized and read full pinned Leibniz Monadology §§31–45 and Spinoza Ethics I def.1,3,7–8, axioms1–7, I6–8 with notes and I11's three proofs. Distinct noncausal positive support routes: Leibniz's whole-contingent-sequence PSR plus necessary final reason in itself (§§32–38,45), and his a priori reality-of-possibilities to essence-involving-existence route (§§43–45); Spinoza's external production exclusion plus separately open internal/external existential explanation fork (I7/I8 note II), and internal consistency/nonexistence or existence-power commitments (I11). Stepwise warrant analysis and the strong independently characterized global-structural rival, with actualness, explanatory coverage, source scope, individual adequacy, exclusion of noncausal/global external reasons and real nature-content all separate, are in docs/notes/intrinsic-existence-reason-1595.md. Added a typed analyst conditional TruthCore.Explanation.IntrinsicReasonBoundary.selectedNatureRecord using EXISTENCE-fact labels, complete contributor+enabler records, worldwise sufficiency, the existing NoExistingSupportAt relation and explicit ForeignReasonSupports/NoFactOrGlobalMember premises. Same nonempty record is preserved; nature, external and global constituents are distinct. Populated finite positive/external/global controls are written; each omission control proves in one model all other hypotheses, the failure of the omitted one and the failure of the conclusion, and a two-being control places the external ingredient on a bearer other than the target. The nature/external split is a constructor tag over the same data, and exhaustiveness of the classification is fixed by the closed inductive type, not a premise. The theorem's conclusion is only candidate intrinsic-only membership, NOT independently adequate metaphysical explanation, not the legacy STMT, not the q3 essence–esse claim, and not a root-route consumer. The module compiles in the CI library build but is unregistered (no Challenge, argument, result or Comparator config), so nothing is certified. PR #1601's independent semantic challenge accepted the theorem at its candidate-level scope; its repairs narrowed the docstring's source claim to the consulted passages (Ethics I16 cor. 1 and I25 schol. on causa sui and efficient causation are not examined). No new historical attribution or closure marking. Intended/actual root-premise delta none.
blocker: A truly adequate, directionally explanatory own-nature reason for this actual individual's positive existence fact is not established by a nature tag, modal sufficiency, actual sourcehood or represented essence–esse identity. The foreign-explanation-to-actual-esse-support conversion and exclusion of adequate global-structural/abstract reasons are contested independent premises; the existence-entailing nature-content and real instantiation require positive warrant. Independently specify a real nature and an explanatory direction/instantiation test that target-copy fails while a positive individual-existence explanation passes, before any conclusion mapped to STMT-NECESSARY-GROUND-HAS-INTRINSIC-REASON.
